observations: Wall-mounted hair dryer with a black arm and two black drying heads.

The control panel has a sticker with 'MANGO' written in red, below which 'AUTOMATICO' is written in black.
The unit is mounted on a black wall bracket with visible screws and a power cord extending from the back.
The background shows a white wall, a mirror, and part of a salon setup including a black bag and a shelf.
No visible damage or wear on the unit in the photos.
The power cord appears intact and is plugged into the wall socket.
